news.headline: Daily-dividend vote and next earnings release need follow-up
news.change: Issuer communications describe November STRC daily dividends at a 12% annual rate as conditional on shareholder approval on October 28. The Q3 earnings call is scheduled for October 29 at 5 pm Eastern. No vote result is inferred.
news.relevance: Review actual approval/effective terms and cash-payment timing before changing the preferred liquidity model.

news.headline: No BTC purchases; STRC claims reduced through repurchases
news.change: Issuer reports 848,517 BTC; 2,068,459 STRC shares repurchased for $204.9 million; $4.83 billion USD reserve and $242.4 million other USD cash.
news.relevance: Repurchase lowers preferred face claims and cash together; does not itself establish a treasury-thesis failure.

news.headline: Latest proxy solicitations continued to advocate daily dividends
news.change: October 20 DEFA14A filings contain management interviews/social communications about the pending daily-dividend vote; no vote result or effective certificate is established by these communications.
news.relevance: Solicitation language about stability/demand remains an issuer claim. The legal amendment still requires the voting and filing conditions.

news.headline: Strategy reached 848,517 BTC; repurchase authorization raised to $3bn
news.change: Week bought 267 BTC for $22.1m, sold 140,872 common shares for $22m net, and repurchased 1,938,780 STRC for $193.1m using USD Cash. USD Reserve paid $45.5m preferred dividends. Reserve $4.83bn; USD Cash $447.3m. Aggregate repurchase authorization is $3bn inclusive of past purchases, with $1.16bn remaining.
news.relevance: Latest official weekly snapshot. Separate $5.2773bn total designated liquidity into reserve/restricted-policy uses and flexible cash; do not assume $3bn is unspent or guaranteed. Buybacks retire preferred claims while spending cash.

news.headline: Board declared November daily STRC payments conditional on vote and charter
news.change: Conditional calendar-day record dates November 1-30, total $1.00/share; first payment November 2 and final payment December 1. If conditions fail, daily payments do not become payable and the semi-monthly fallback remains.
news.relevance: An already-declared conditional schedule is stronger than a marketing intention but still depends on approval and timely effective documents.

news.headline: MSCI adopted non-operating-company eligibility screens
news.change: New operating-asset/five-ratio framework takes effect November 30 close; final affected list scheduled November 11. January deferral of the narrow DATCO proposal is not the current policy endpoint.
